messages:
maya: Quick kickoff 680 Need a tight landing copy + lead routing for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Main goals: clarity, benchmark signposting, and webinar CTA routing.
owen: Agreed. Keep hero CTAs to one clear action each. e.g., Hosted: 'Start free', Dedicated: 'Book capacity', Private: 'Contact sales'.
rebecca: Benchmark microcopy idea: 'Typical p50: 55	6ms; improved with batching & KV cache. Full report -> /benchmarks'. No raw pricing on page.
juan: For forms: add hidden input `mode` and capture utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch. Mapping: hosted -> trial workflow; dedicated -> SDR capacity queue; private -> AE with security packet.
maya: Webinar copy: 'Live demo: runtime, smart routing, and fallbacks' CTA: 'Register  see throughput'. Add checkbox 'I'm evaluating Dedicated/Private' to steer routing.
owen: Asset list for launch post: 1) latency compare GIF, 2) 30s demo clip, 3) 1-pager benchmark PDF. We'll surface the PDF on a /benchmarks modal.
rebecca: Also link to evals: '/evals/onboarding-sample' so technical buyers can probe model outputs. Include a short prompt set note under 'Quality & evals'.
juan: Implementation note: form example: `<input type="hidden" name="mode" value="hosted">`. Add mapping in HubSpot/CRM.
maya: Plan: I'll draft a content matrix with hero, subhead, micro-bullets, CTA, and routing. Please review in Notion by EOD Friday.
ops-bot: Reminder: webinar slot booked for 2026-04-07 16:00 UTC 1: Event ID 98321.
owen: Reviewing now, will add A/B test: hero CTA 'Watch demo' vs 'See throughput' for conversion.
rebecca: One more: Dedicated hero microcopy: 'Reserved capacity  predictable throughput & SLAs' subhead: 'Autoscaling, burst, and predictable QPS'.
maya: Thanks everyone 44D I'll post the Notion draft and tag the team.
